email.body1:
Kyle, saw EliseAI crossed $200M ARR after five straight years of 100% growth and is hiring hundreds post Series E.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can route and touch before the new reps ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kyle, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Doubling every year, board expectations on pipeline tend to outpace what headcount can cover, and most RevOps teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EliseAI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kyle, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kyle, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem. Hiring hundreds at once is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything right after a raise.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to EliseAI either way.
